_note: Transcribed from the official syllabus page supplied by the team. Topic names are copied as listed there (including its own spelling, e.g. 'sprint').
source: B.Tech / M.Tech (Integrated) Programmes, Regulations 2021, Volume 2 (Revised July 2023), First Year Syllabi - Control Copy, pages 67-68

topics: Introduction to C: structure of the C program
Values, names, scope, binding, storage classes
Numeric data types: integer, floating point
Non-numeric data types: char and string
L value and R value in expression
Conditional statements: simple if, if...else, else if and nested if
Unconditional control statements: break, continue, goto
Accessing, indexing and operations with 1D arrays
String functions: gets(), puts(), getchar(), putchar(), printf()
Built-in string functions: atoi, strlen, strcat, strcmp
String functions: sprint, sscanf, strrev, strcpy, strstr, strtok
Function with and without return values
Basic data types: integers, floating points, boolean types
Working with input and output functions
Single and multi-line comments / error handling
Conditional and looping statements: if, for, while
Speed testing between NumPy and Pandas

Problem Solving & Programming Concepts, Maureen Sprankle and Jim Hubbard, Prentice Hall, 9th ed. [chapters 1 to 7]
Python Datascience Handbook, Jake VanderPlas, O'Reilly, 2017 [chapters 2 & 3]
Python for Beginners, Timothy C. Needham, 2019 [chapters 1 to 4]
